name_reason: Compliant fd2_ game-function name. '47' is the per-event dispatch index 0x47 (table entry @ 0x51CAD), a meaningful domain ID, not address residue. Descriptor corrected from '__unref_dyn_turn_event' to '__ch28_mech_defeat_seq': the slot is LIVE, reached via the ch28 kill-drop path -- ch28 char_spawn_records[0..1] = the mech squad (機甲隊長, enemy_data 48, char_id 0x74, lv33, x2) each carry pickup_kind=2 param=0x47, so each mech's death dispatches consequence[0x47], a 2-kill state machine that (on the 2nd kill) shows dialog page 2 and clears the remaining mech squad. The earlier 'unref' verdict only scanned turn-event/tile-step hooks and missed the kill-drop path; '_dyn_turn_event' was also imprecise (no turn-event scheduling here).
purpose: Chapter 28 mech-defeat staged sequence (dispatch idx 0x47, reached via the ch28 kill-drop path when a mech-squad unit records[0..1] enemy_data 48, pickup_kind=2 param=0x47, falls): a priming counter at tile_event_consumed_flags[0x13] that, on the 2nd mech kill, shows dialog page 2 and mass-kills runtime chars from index 0x14 to the end (clears the remaining mech squad).
logic_summary: Reads gate byte tile_event_consumed_flags[0x13] (via data_fd2_field_map_tile_event_consumed_flags_ptr + 0x13). If non-zero (i.e. already invoked at least once): calls fd2_display_dialog_scene(data_fd2_current_chapter_text, page=2, 0xA0000, 0x140, 0xCD, 0x4C, 0x4A, 0x13, 1) then fd2_kill_runtime_chars_from_index_to_end(0x14). In all cases it then increments that gate byte by 1 (8-bit INC). First call only primes the counter 0->1; the dialog+mass-kill fires from the 2nd call onward. event_arg is unread. Disassembly confirms exact match: PUSH 0x28/CALL __CHK prologue, MOV EAX,[0x53ad5]; CMP byte [EAX+0x13],0; JZ skip; 9 pushes + CALL fd2_display_dialog_scene; PUSH 0x14 + CALL kill; MOV EAX,[0x53ad5]; INC byte [EAX+0x13]; own RET (no borrowed shared tail).
